description: A vintage, blue CRT television with a screen displaying a hazy landscape of a hill or mountain by the water during sunset. The television features a black bezel around the screen, a control panel with three small circular buttons, a vertical slider, and two larger circular dials. Below the controls, there's a speaker grille and a circular emblem with the text 'CAMSTEIN' embossed on it. An antenna extends from the top of the television. The overall aesthetic suggests a retro or early digital era.
